🚀 Hiring: Technical Product Manager – Remote

We are looking for an experienced Technical Product Manager with a strong healthcare background to join a dynamic team and drive the strategy, development, and delivery of healthcare technology platforms.

📍 Location: Remote
📌 Experience Required:
• 12+ years of overall professional experience
• 6+ years of Technical Product Management experience
• 3+ years in Healthcare or HealthTech

🔹 Key Responsibilities:
• Define product vision, technical strategy, and multi-year roadmaps for healthcare platforms.
• Translate complex clinical and operational workflows (patient outreach, care coordination, etc.) into scalable and reusable technical solutions.
• Collaborate with engineering, data science, clinical, compliance, and business teams to deliver high-impact products.
• Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations and standards, including HIPAA, GxP, and HL7.
• Drive interoperability initiatives by integrating platforms with EHRs, CRM systems, and healthcare ecosystems.
• Monitor system performance, data quality, KPIs, and SLAs while leading continuous improvement efforts.
• Act as the bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment across teams.

🔹 Required Skills:
✅ Healthcare domain expertise with knowledge of:
• Medical & Pharmacy Claims
• Electronic Health Records (EHR)
• Healthcare APIs and Integration Patterns

✅ Technical proficiency in:
• SQL
• Tableau or other Data Visualization to
